sourceBoundary: Latest unique protected WOW List PostgreSQL snapshot available in the reviewed archive.

geographicActivity.populationDefinition: Nonblank city or region labels attached through post geolocation; thresholds count posts or events, not people, organizers, chapters, or current communities.
